a_complete: All 180 original M6 positions are measured and the exact favorable count agrees with frozen A and M6.
failed: An unresolved execution, recovery, identity or verification failure blocks the position even with another positive.
historical_attempt_failure: Retained failed attempt, never a zero. An exact-task verified retry can resolve the required task; unrelated positives cannot do so.
negative_complete: Both orientations completed all required records without qualifying unintended evidence, under the complete native greedy-report policy; not all possible RNA structures.
negative_reported_pair: One complete native greedy-report trace has no qualifying unintended witness; other records/orientations may remain.
not_required_for_union_P_after_positive: Unattempted work unnecessary for settled union P; species search coverage remains incomplete.
outside_panel: Outside frozen admission; no combined panel rank.
p_complete: All 180 union flags are independently decided and agree with retained P; species searches may remain incomplete.
positive_complete: A verified unintended witness settles union P; unattempted species/records are not thereby assessed.
ranking_eligible: Every frozen admission for this gene has complete A/P, verified exact M8 scores and verified within-panel ranks/ties.
selected_complete: Frozen admission with complete A/P measurements; score verification and gene ranking eligibility are separate fields.
selected_incomplete: Frozen admission with unavailable A and/or P; missing measurements and dependent scores are null.
species_partial_unresolved: Some native pairs assessed in this species, without a witness or complete-policy negative.
species_untested: No native pair assessed in this species/position.
unresolved: Missing, partial, ambiguous or capped required work; P and dependent scores remain null.
